milestone.describes: A Dodge round plays: the ship, the AMMO and BAD GUYS gauges, particle effects, and a timer counting up.

steps.expect: The menu: the OMIUM logo drawn in drifting particles, with Dodge, Juggle, Infinite and a greyed-out More Games listed under it.
The Dodge instruction screen: the ship, the AMMO gauge, the mirrored two-player layout and a 0.00 timer.
The round is running: the timer is counting up and particle effects are moving. Two captures several seconds apart differ.

notes: The bundle identifier really is `com.eeenmachine.`, with a trailing dot and no app segment. It is not a truncation.
`Press here to play` is at (384, 512). An earlier version of the app note gave (384, 631) for it; that is the Dodge entry on the menu screen before it, not the start button.

Coordinates are client coordinates for the 768x1024 portrait window. On a display with scaling, converting them through ClientToScreen from a DPI-aware process lands somewhere else — measure the target from a screen capture instead.
The round proves itself by the timer counting rather than by anything moving on its own: check two captures a few seconds apart differ.

The instruction and play screens are mirrored top to bottom on purpose: it is a two-player game on one iPad, so the second player's half is rotated 180 degrees to face them. That is the app's design, not a rendering fault.
